title: Cloud-OpsBench: A Reproducible Benchmark for Agentic Root Cause Analysis in Cloud Systems
abstract: arXiv:2603.00468v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly explored for automating root cause analysis (RCA) in cloud-native systems, creating a need to evaluate both diagnostic correctness and the quality of the supporting investigation. Existing static benchmarks offer repeatable inputs but limited system-facing interaction, while live testbeds expose realistic tools but hinder controlled comparison because incident evidence varies across runs; both paradigms focus primarily on final answers. It comprises 754 runtime-verified cases across 57 fault types on two microservice workloads spanning application services and Kubernetes platform layers. translated_title: Cloud-OpsBench：面向云系统中智能体根因分析的可复现基准
translated_abstract: 摘要：大型语言模型代理正越来越多地被探索用于自动化云原生系统中的根因分析（RCA），这需要评估诊断正确性以及支持性调查的质量。现有静态基准提供可重复的输入，但系统面向交互有限，而实时测试平台暴露真实工具，但因事件证据在不同运行中变化而阻碍受控比较；这两种范式主要关注最终答案。为解决这些限制，我们提出了Cloud-OpsBench，一个用于交互式和证据基础的云RCA评估基础设施。它包含754个运行时验证案例，涵盖57种故障类型，涉及两个微服务工作负载，跨越应用服务和Kubernetes平台层。每个故障被捕获为状态快照，并通过标准诊断接口重放，附带结果标签和诊断证据图，支持匹配比较和过程评估。
tldr: 本文提出了Cloud-OpsBench，一个可复现的交互式云系统根因分析基准，通过运行时验证案例和证据图支持诊断正确性与调查过程的双重评估。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Cloud-OpsBench, a reproducible interactive benchmark for cloud root cause analysis, enabling evaluation of both diagnostic correctness and investigation quality via runtime-verified cases and evidence graphs.
